# Checklist

The code reviewer should check the acceptance criteria from the linked issues are achieved.

In addition, the proposer should check the following before merge:
- [ ] Tests have run and passed via GitHub Actions.
- [ ] If PR is a bug fix or substantive change to code, new tests are included where appropriate.
- [ ] Documentation has been updated to reflect user-facing changes in code.
- [ ] If PR makes changes to documentation, it has been built and viewed locally to check formatting.
- [ ] If there are files in the repository that this PR makes obsolete, they are deleted.
- [ ] [ONLY CHECK DIRECTLY BEFORE MERGE] The most recent version of main has been merged into the feature branch locally.
- [ ] [ONLY CHECK DIRECTLY BEFORE MERGE] The last commit before merge is an autogenerated commit from bump-my-version.
- [ ] [ONLY CHECK DIRECTLY BEFORE MERGE] The tag associated with the version bump has been pushed to GitHub.

If this checklist does not make sense, please see the [contributing guidelines](CONTRIBUTING.md). It is not an exhaustive list but intended to prevent common omissions.
